role: d.ents: the digest of every server entity's id and NBT across the overworld, Nether and End pass orders, shared by the snapshot gate and play --check.
gpu: function sr_entity_digest: builds a tree per entity per call in the nbt scratch region (check path, not simulation); nbtbin_long_memo keeps a copy of its scratch bytes when it changed
function sr_entity_digest: switches the replay's current dimension (serverreplay_enter) as a side effect, skipping a dimension whose pass list is empty
notes: Mirrors the oracle's digest in oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Rows.java (not a oracle/src file). Pools: 0 item/orb, 1 falling/hanging, 3 player, dragon and crystal pools, else an_ent living or projectile.
